bold.description: The toolbar button for the bold mark.

italic.description: The toolbar button for the italic mark.

underline.description: The toolbar button for the underline mark.

strike.description: The toolbar button for the strikethrough mark.

code.description: The toolbar button for the inline code mark.

heading.description: The toolbar's block type dropdown entry for a heading, and the trigger's text when the selection is in one; the level is 1 to 6.

bulletList.description: The toolbar button for a bulleted list.

orderedList.description: The toolbar button for a numbered list.

blockquote.description: The toolbar button for a block quotation.

codeBlock.description: The toolbar button for a code block.

rule.description: The toolbar button that inserts a horizontal rule.

undo.description: The toolbar button that undoes the last change.

redo.description: The toolbar button that redoes the last undone change.

paragraph.description: The block type dropdown's entry for a plain paragraph, beside the headings; it is also the trigger's text when the selection is in one.
